instruction.sound: What will this seedling grow in to?

feedback.end: This is a young tree. Young trees are also known as saplings.

instruction.text: What do you see in the picture?
What will grow from these flowers?

feedback.end: This is an apple tree! These pretty white flowers will eventually grow into delicious apples.

instruction.text: What grows inside of an apple?

feedback.end: That’s right! Like the corn plant, a mature apple tree grows fruit that holds seeds. These seeds can grow brand new apple trees, starting the cycle all over again.
